recommendation: Provide patient education and support for hypertension management
implementation_steps: Provide culturally sensitive education on hypertension and its management
Support self-measured blood pressure (SMBP) monitoring with proper technique training
Facilitate lifestyle changes such as dietary modification and increased physical activity
Connect patients to community resources for ongoing support
Bridge gaps in health literacy, language, and trust
evidence_summary: CHW-led hypertension education and support interventions have demonstrated improvements in blood pressure control, particularly in underserved and minority populations with limited access to traditional healthcare services.
citation: Implementation Strategies to Improve Blood Pressure Control in the United States
